scenario: Inbound IPv4 is restricted, but IPv6 is open to the Internet and outbound provider tags are accepted without expansion or resource-level controls.
missing_evidence: IPv6 disabled proof at edge, load balancer, cloud firewall, and host
service tag expansion source and timestamp
region or service filter for provider tag
private endpoint, identity condition, resource policy, or origin validation
provider range refresh owner and failed-refresh alert
expected_findings: FW-DUAL-01: public IPv6 allow exists while IPv4 is restricted
FW-DUAL-02: IPv6 absence is assumed without effective-path evidence
FW-TAG-01: provider service tag is accepted without expansion evidence
FW-TAG-02: broad provider tag lacks resource-level controls
FW-DRIFT-01: provider range allowlist has no owner or refresh evidence
